svg.title: Workflow: Conversational analytics (sales & market data)
svg.desc: Solution workflow (conversational) for Conversational analytics (sales & market data): 1 trigger: Business user asks a question in natural language → request with persona; 2 guardrail: Persona access control and region/brand scope applied before any query → scoped request; 3 system: Catalog sync pulls table and column metadata from Google BigQuery → governed metadata catalog; 4 agent: Reads guidance, synonym map and field annotations; resolves metric and entities → query plan; 5 decision: Native text-to-SQL can see the custom fields? yes → step 6 / no → step 7; 6 skill: Generates SQL at runtime from the catalog and runs it on BigQuery → result set; 7 skill: Calls the domain query skill or cross-domain join skill → result set; 8 agent: Answers with table, period and scope using business labels, refusing schema enumeration and out-of-scope data → answer; 9 system: Logs tokens, cost and response time per query → cost and latency record; 10 human: QA reviewers score the harness run against ground truths computed outside the platform → pass rate; 11 outcome: Self-serve answers with consistency to certified reports and transparent cost → fewer analyst tickets
